offers_products.reason: Copart mainly runs auctions as an agent for sellers; vehicles are mostly consigned, not its own products.

offers_services.reason: Provides online auction, vehicle remarketing, towing, storage and title-handling services for insurers and other vehicle sellers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Individual members can bid on and buy used and salvage cars, motorcycles and trucks, though dealers dominate.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Insurance companies, dealers, dismantlers, rebuilders and fleet owners consign and buy vehicles through its auctions.

recurring_revenue.reason: Insurers and dealers repeatedly consign and buy vehicles; steady fees on millions of transactions each year.

cyclical_demand.reason: Volume driven by insurance total-loss vehicles from accidents; supply and demand for salvage cars hold up in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Typical sale is a single used or salvage vehicle; moderate value, and most buyers are dealers who buy frequently.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from its online auction platform and yard network, not mainly staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Buyers are mostly dealers, dismantlers, rebuilders and individuals; sellers include insurers, but many buyers are small businesses.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates large networks of physical salvage yards and storage lots requiring ongoing land and facility investment to grow.

notes: Insurers are major sellers and also customers for services; buyers include both businesses and some public buyers.
